messages:
morgan: quick postmortem follow-up — noticed TLS handshake spike + retry storm during cross-region failover. starting action list.
chloe: can you drop the healthcheck logs snippet?
morgan: pasted below
morgan: ```
[2026-03-22T09:14:01Z] hb check failed backend-a us-west-2 502 TLS_HANDSHAKE
[2026-03-22T09:14:02Z] failover triggered -> routed to backend-b eu-west-1
[2026-03-22T09:14:02Z] backend-b healthcheck ok but returning old cert chain
[2026-03-22T09:14:03Z] client retries -> increased latency
```
sam: hmm looks like healthcheck TTL mismatch + cert propagation lag on backend-b. could be config drift in edge->backend SNI mapping.
alex: agree. also saw some LB rules with old target group weights during the flip.
chloe: found a config diff in terraform that kept the staged cert ref for eu-west-1
priya: can we temporary increase healthcheck timeout and disable aggressive retries while we fix cert refs? that should buy us time.
morgan: temp mitigations proposed: 1) bump healthcheck timeout to 10s 2) add short circuit breaker on retry count 3) force sync certs to backends in eu-west-1
sam: i'll own the routing/debug work — @sam. plan: packet captures, verify SNI headers, confirm cert chain. ETA: EOD tomorrow (2026-03-23 23:59 UTC).
alex: i'll open a PR for the healthcheck timeout + retry-policy change. will include rollback step. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482
chloe: i'll patch the terraform cert ref and run a dry-run. if green i'll apply with @infra-oncall approval.
infra-oncall: noted, will coordinate the apply window. prefer low traffic window (02:00-04:00 UTC).
priya: i'll add dashboards: TLS handshake fails by region, retry rate, and healthcheck duration. will also add alert: region TLS > 0.5% for 5m.
morgan: recorded action items in the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-healthcheck-tls-failover
morgan: owners + deadlines:
- sam: routing/SNI debug + packet captures — ETA 2026-03-23 EOD
- alex: PR for healthcheck/retry policy + test — ETA 2026-03-23 midday
- chloe: terraform cert ref fix + apply window coordination — ETA 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC
- priya: dashboards/alerts + runbook snippet — ETA 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC
- morgan: follow-up sync + verify actions closed — ETA 2026-03-25 09:00 PT
sam: I'm going to run the pcap now and will post findings in this thread.
sam: initial note: SNI header for some backends was empty during failover; likely routing sidecar didn't forward host header on probe. reproducing.
alex: PR opened -> link above. added explicit retry_backoff and max_retries: 2 for healthcheck.
chloe: terraform dry-run clean. scheduling apply with @infra-oncall at 02:30 UTC.
infra-oncall: scheduled, will notify pager 30m before apply. :bell:
priya: dashboards up, alert rules staged. will escalate to pager if threshold breached after the patch.
morgan: recurring pattern: saw similar small spikes on 2026-01-17 and 2026-02-10. adding 90-day incident pattern review to action items.
chloe: added timeline and linked previous incidents in the doc.
sam: thanks team — will post pcap summary and next steps after analysis. :thumbsup:
morgan: thanks all, follow-up sync set for 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. please update the doc when items done.
